name: sqrail-site
description: Validation and Cloudflare deployment tooling for the sqrail documentation site

scripts.format: prettier --write .htmlvalidate.json package.json plugin.json "*.md" "docs/*.md" "benchmarks/*.md" "benchmarks/agent-eval/*.md" ".github/**/*.md" ".github/**/*.yml" "skills/**/*.md" "skills/**/*.yaml" "site/**/*.html" "site/**/*.md" site/styles.css site/app.js "tools/*.mjs" wrangler.jsonc
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .htmlvalidate.json package.json plugin.json "*.md" "docs/*.md" "benchmarks/*.md" "benchmarks/agent-eval/*.md" ".github/**/*.md" ".github/**/*.yml" "skills/**/*.md" "skills/**/*.yaml" "site/**/*.html" "site/**/*.md" site/styles.css site/app.js "tools/*.mjs" wrangler.jsonc
scripts.site:check: npm run format:check && npm run docs:check && npm run agent:check && npm run site:navigation && npm run site:html && npm run site:js && npm run cloudflare:check
